# Claude API Pricing vs Subscription

> Free interactive calculator comparing Claude API token costs against Pro and Max subscription plans, with a daily breakeven estimate. Independent and unaffiliated with Anthropic. Prices last verified: 2026-10-14.

## Key facts (cite these)
- Claude API prices per million tokens (input/output), October 2026: Opus 5.5 $4/$20 (cached input $0.20); Opus 5 $5/$25 (cached $0.50); Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10 (cached $0.10); Sonnet 5 $2/$10; Sonnet 4.x $3/$15; Haiku 4.5 $1/$5 (cached $0.10); Haiku 5.5 $0.10/$0.50 (cached $0.01).
- Claude subscriptions 2026: Free $0; Pro $20/month (or $17/month billed annually); Max 5x $100/month; Max 20x $200/month; Team $20–25/seat standard, $100–125 premium.
- Breakeven: on Sonnet 5.5 with a 10:1 input/output mix, API cost passes the $20 Pro plan at roughly 220K input tokens/day (~22K output). Worked examples at three usage tiers are on the page.
- Paid plans use rolling 5-hour session windows plus weekly caps across web, desktop, mobile and Claude Code; the API has no usage caps.

## Pages
- [/](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/): breakeven calculator + full price tables + decision guide + FAQ
- [/claude-code-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/claude-code-pricing): Claude Code cost —
  included in Pro $20 / Max 5x $100 / Max 20x $200 (no separate fee), shared 5-hour windows + weekly caps,
  API-key mode rates, three worked monthly budgets.

## Model pricing guides (Oct 2026)

- [/deepseek-v4-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/deepseek-v4-pricing): DeepSeek V4 API pricing —
  V4-Pro $0.66-1.32 in / $1.98-3.96 out per 1M; V4.1-Flash $0.15-0.30 / $0.60-1.20; off-peak (all hours except
  01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC Mon-Fri) = half price; cache-hit input from $0.003; aggregator comparison.
- [/deepseek-v4-vs-claude-opus](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/deepseek-v4-vs-claude-opus): V4 Pro vs
  Claude Opus 5.5 cost math — ~3-10x price gaps by component, 1M vs 200K context, worked workload costs,
  when each model wins. Budget face added: V4.1-Flash vs Opus 5.5 — $0.30/$1.20 peak (13x/17x cheaper, ~27x off-peak input); ~$450/month vs $6,600/month at 30M+5M tokens/day.
- [/kling-3-0-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/kling-3-0-pricing): Kling 3.0 cost — per-second
  credits (6/s at 720p, 12/s at 1080p+audio), plans from $6.99 first month, ~45 credits for a 5s 720p clip. Version ladder added: 1.5 (legacy, cheapest) → 2.1 Master/2.5 Turbo (~70cr/5s 1080p) → 2.6 (cost/quality sweet spot) → 3.0 (audio+4K+multi-shot, ~2-5x credits of 2.x era) → 3.0 Omni (reference workflows); upgrade math = pay 3.0 premium only when audio/realism is the deliverable.
- [/gemini-4-argon-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/gemini-4-argon-pricing): Gemini 4 Argon API pricing —
  intro $2 in / $10 out per 1M (output incl. thinking) through Nov 30 2026, doubling to $4/$20 from Dec 1 2026;
  Batch always 50% off ($1/$5 → $2/$10); implicit cached input $0.10 → $0.20 (95% off fresh); Priority $3.60/$18 → $7.20/$36;
  no free tier (paid-only, unlike 3.8 Flash at $0.75/$3.75 → $1.50/$7.50 from Jan 1 2027); ~1M context, released Oct 13 2026;
  worked workload (30M+5M tokens/day): $3,300/mo intro → $6,600/mo after Dec 1 = exactly Opus 5.5's current price;
  grounding 5,000 free Search/Maps req/mo then $14/1K. Rates verified on ai.google.dev rate card Oct 16 2026.
- [/gpt-5-6-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/gpt-5-6-pricing): GPT-5.6 API pricing — Sol $4/$20
  (promotional at least through Nov 21 2026, originally $5/$30), Terra $2/$12, Luna $0.20/$1.20 per 1M;
  worked 30M+5M/day math: Sol $6,600/mo (=Opus territory) / Terra $3,600 / Luna $360; vs Sonnet 5.5 $2/$10
  Terra pays +$2 output; value-tier case after GPT-6 Astra ($10/$50) launch. Verified Oct 17 2026.
- [/kimi-k3-pricing](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/kimi-k3-pricing): Kimi K3 API pricing — $3 input /
  $15 output per 1M, cached input $0.30 (90% off), 1M context (1,048,576); K2.6/K2.7 Code budget line ~$0.95/$4;
  OpenRouter batch route ~$0.25/$14.23; 75%-cache worked math cuts $4,950→$3,125/mo; honest vs Claude: pricier than
  Sonnet 5.5 at list, cheaper than Opus 5.5 output, structural case = 1M context. Verified Oct 17 2026.
- [/muse-spark-vs-claude-app](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/muse-spark-vs-claude-app): Muse Spark vs
  Claude app & API — Meta's open-weight 816B MoE (42B active, 1M context, Oct 15 2026) at $1.25/$4.25 via
  OpenRouter vs Opus 5.5 $4/$20; worked 30M+5M/day math: $1,763/mo vs $6,600 Opus / $3,300 Sonnet;
  self-host reality check (816B needs 512GB-class hardware at $15-25/hr); benchmark honesty: Opus leads
  SWE-bench Verified/Pro, Muse Spark 1.2 86.6% at $0.55-1.25 per solved task, 1.3 edges Opus 5 on DeepSWE;
  verdict: bulk long-context work to Muse Spark, frontier agentic slice to Opus. Verified Oct 18 2026.
- [/gemini-4-argon-vs-opus-5-5](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/gemini-4-argon-vs-opus-5-5): Argon vs Opus 5.5 interactive cost comparison. Both $4/$20 per MTok after Dec 1, 2026; Argon intro $2/$10 (half price) until Nov 30; batch permanently half of Opus list.
- [/claude-token-calculator](https://claude-api-pricing.vercel.app/claude-token-calculator): per-request Claude token cost calculator across all models, with a what-$1-buys reference table (Opus 5.5: $1 = 50K output tokens).
